items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 88:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Netzach and Hod becoming one in the Nukva? Even at the time of the greatness, when the Netzach and Hod were already separated one from the other in ZA, as above in Answer 86, nevertheless it is discerned that in the head of the Nukva, where the NHY of ZA clothe, the Netzach and Hod become attached one to the other within her. And this is for another reason. For it was explained above that the two crowns (Atrin), which are Tifferet and Yesod, have an equal relation to the Netzach and Hod. As above in Answer 86, and in Answer 6, see there. And it was explained above in Part 13 that in the aspect of the surrounding lights they are four Mochin — Hochma, Bina, Hesed, and Gevura — but in the aspect of the inner ones, when they clothe in the head of ZA, the two crowns of Hesed and Gevura are joined into a single aspect, into the brain of Daat, in the secret of the Shin of the three heads.
